context: Correct exact source glyph and cat proportions in two reviewed collectible card designs.

params.prompt: Edit the supplied finished card in Image one. Change only its central emblem. Image two is the exact source glyph authority. Faithfully extract the complete black glyph from Image two and place that identical silhouette centrally on the existing dark field, preserving its exact upright orientation, original proportions, horizontal upper stroke, curved descending stem, stroke weight, terminals and negative space. Trace the source geometry directly rather than reinterpreting or stylizing its shape. Leave the source white background out. Render the exact black filled silhouette with only a fine satin silver edge highlight so it remains legible on the existing black material. Retain every other part of Image one unchanged: its smooth rounded rim, restrained silver edge, dark ceramic field, continuous fine contour grooves, lighting, texture and original composition. The entire finished card is wordless, with no added markings. Output the same flat front view and thin printed finish.

Create an immaculate premium collector card print. Reproduce the exact real cat in Image one as the central figure, preserving its face markings, narrow forward facing head, short natural fur and slim upright torso. Its viewer left foreleg hangs lower beside the body, while its viewer right forepaw bends at chest level. Retain the original gray and white coat pattern, natural eye shape, small nose, standing hind feet and quiet expression. Image two supplies only the matching thin rounded frame materials: pale ivory ceramic, fine ribbed silver rails and a restrained warm wood accent. Surround the source faithful cat with a single continuous finished ivory material field and subtle source inspired floor grain. Keep the full rounded printed edge smooth and refined, the composition straight on, the materials crisp and the illumination soft and even. The cat is the sole hero. The finished image contains no caption, lettering, labels, numbers or writing panels.
